entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Rajdevi Temple is a Hindu temple and Shakti Peethas in Eastern Nepal. The primary deity is Rajdevi. It is situated in the Rajdevi Tole, Rajbiraj, Saptari and draws Nepali and Indian pilgrims, especially in Bada Dashain. Thousands of goats are sacrificed there during Dashain.
